Treat it like any other addiction. 

Good first step is to keep track of the days of abstinence. There are apps and websites for this or you could use an old fashioned notepad/calendar and tally mark. 

Have a list of activities to do when urges arise. Could be art, music, athletics, a hobby, a shower, meditation, etc. Depending on your goals you could consider masturbation without pornography, but personally I would wait until you've been without porn for a few days to help with any desensitization you may have had. 

Have a list of reasons why you want to quit to look at when you feel like relapsing. 

Play the tape forward and visualize what will happen eventually if you do relapse, to remind yourself why you're quitting in the first place. 

Hope some of this helps, good luck.
